findings.title: Historical writes admitted invalid or synthetic OHLCV
findings.mechanism: Single inserts silently acknowledged rejected values; batches skipped rows or fabricated extrema/volume. Invalid batches are now errors, with atomic rollback and no imputation.
limits: No operational consumer found by targeted crates/src search
Existing stored datasets were not repaired

findings.title: Read errors, overflow and fallback paths hid provenance loss
findings.mechanism: Fallible opening no longer redirects to a shared temporary database; row failures propagate; integer/range/limit/prune domains are explicit.
limits: Legacy wrappers still return empty/None or log errors
new panics on failed initialization; callers should prefer try_new
100000-row resource budget retained and made explicit

findings.title: Historical primary key cannot identify multi-venue multi-interval observations
findings.mechanism: The (coin_id,timestamp) key aliases bars from different intervals, venues or universe versions under those conditions.
limits: Requires versioned migration, not inferred historical labels

findings.title: Unknown intention tags were reinterpreted as swing
findings.mechanism: Decoder accepts only declared tags and validates persisted domains; input and deletion coordinates use checked conversions; invalid writes return errors.
limits: Legacy SCALP/SWING records remain readable for migration
Schema and recovery scope remain incomplete

findings.title: Intentions and snapshots omit sufficient state and continuous position identity
findings.mechanism: One intention per tag and a latest-only getter cannot restore all spectral slots, learned state or event frontiers. Unconditional upsert can replace newer time with older time.
limits: Need event/revision authority contract before rejecting late writes

findings.title: Partial XOR checksum and unchecked checkpoint metadata
findings.mechanism: Direction, risk fields and time are uncovered; swapping size/entry and adding 64 to coin_id collide. Loader accepts unsupported version, negative capital and arbitrary global checksum.
limits: Three passing tests assert presence of the defect, not repair

findings.title: Shared temporary publication and unsupported recovery complexity guarantees
findings.mechanism: with_extension(tmp) aliases destinations/writers. JSON serialization scales with state size; no consistent-cut protocol or power-failure experiment supports O(1), zero-copy or sub-ms claims.
limits: File sync alone is not graph consistency

findings.title: Warmup admitted infinities and inconsistent OHLCV
findings.mechanism: Both warmup routes now share strict parsing/geometry and rejection counts; the used route previously admitted infinite open and open outside extrema.
limits: Timestamps, order, closure, gaps and completeness remain unrepresented

findings.title: Called training placeholder and alternative boot checks do not prove adaptation or recovery
findings.mechanism: Training returns Some(()) without using history/lr/epochs. The bin calls it with genome-derived parameters. Alternative recovery only inventories in-memory positions without loading or comparing state.
limits: This does not imply all project training is empty

findings.title: WalStorage synthesizes zero observations and overstates WAL durability
findings.mechanism: Invalid price/volume become zero and insert succeeds; timestamp wraps and symbol is unchecked. NORMAL durability claims exceed SQLite's documented power-loss guarantees.
limits: Pragmas unchanged; no universal FULL policy imposed

theory.name: Sufficient state, consistent cuts and observational recovery equivalence
acceptance: Replay with and without injected failure must preserve per-event features, decisions and terminal effects under declared tolerances
Identify observations, learned state, policy, genome and event frontiers separately
Deduplicate external effects and reconcile exchange state
Declare temporal support and numerical approximation error
